title: Purple Serpent Visionaries
description: A surreal painting features a large purple snake with a crown of autumn leaves and multicolored eyes coiled around four dark-skinned women wearing colorful headwraps. One woman holds a crystal ball showing a planet, while the snake's body weaves through a lavender field with mountains, a red starry sky, and small white figures in the foreground.
prompt: surreal symbolic artwork of a giant purple snake with green and yellow eyes and autumn leaf crown coiled around four African women with intricate colorful headwraps, one woman holds a glowing crystal ball with a planet inside, set against a field of purple lavender flowers, dark mountains in background, red cosmic sky with shooting stars and planets, small white outlined figures on reddish ground, mystical and vibrant colors with dripping paint effects, detailed linework and patterns
